title: Exact UTF-16 comparison and tie identity
summary: Commons Lang and Guava compare two bounded strings over unrestricted UTF-16 units. Guava min exposes which equal reference it retained.

subject.system: Exact UTF-16 comparison and tie identity

change.description: Commons Lang and Guava compare two bounded strings over unrestricted UTF-16 units. Guava min exposes which equal reference it retained.

notes: The opening comparison uses the released JARs and Temurin 21.0.13. The standalone, ordinary native, integrated JBMC and physical JVM evidence is measured per statement.
The JVM checked 5,329 boundary pairs. Sign normalization failed on 4,756, and Guava min kept the first reference on all 73 equal-valued distinct ties.
